t: Greetings to the Russian national school students’ team on their victory in the 5th Open World Astronomy Olympiad 2026
d: Vladimir Putin congratulated Yakov Bakhtiyarov, Nikolai Gamynin, Maxim Zalesky, Mikhail Lazarev, Yevgeny Motkov and Uvan Pruglo of the Russian national school students’ team on their victory in the 5th Open World Astronomy Olympiad 2026.
